note: Canonical feature taxonomy. Competitor records reference these ids. Support values: Yes | No | Partial | Unknown. Unknown is a real answer — never guess.

features.label: Multifamily-specific content library
features.why: A generic LMS gives you a delivery mechanism; the question is what goes in it.

features.label: Content maintained and updated by the vendor
features.why: Who owns keeping courses current as regulation changes.

features.label: State-specific compliance content
features.why: Multi-state portfolios need jurisdiction variants, not one national course.

features.label: Competency assessment, not just completion
features.why: Completion proves attendance. Competency proves what they know.

features.label: Mobile and offline access
features.why: Maintenance techs and leasing consultants are not at desks.

features.label: Short-form microlearning library
features.why: Onsite teams do not have an hour. A 2-to-5-minute lesson gets taken; a 45-minute course gets deferred.

features.label: Performance management (reviews, goals, PIPs)
features.why: Enterprise RFPs ask for it as a Must Have. Know exactly what we do and do not have before the question lands.

features.label: Record retention, archiving and export
features.why: The answer to a litigation hold or a multi-year audit. Decides deals quietly and is rarely demoed.

features.label: Distinct content types matched to the learning need
features.why: A generic LMS has one format. Which format a topic gets — course, Spark, Booster, In the Know — is a design decision, and it is the thing a rep most often flattens.

features.label: State / jurisdiction-specific variants
features.why: Ask what a vendor means by "variant": a separate policy version per state, or a federal document with localization guidance. Grace Hill ships a federal baseline you localize in the editor — read the note before answering this one in a state-law deal.

features.label: Full-text search of policy content
features.why: Not just document titles — the distinction that brought one customer back.

features.label: Ask an AI assistant a question about policy content

features.label: Review and approval workflow with an audit trail
features.why: A policy that changed without a recorded approval is the thing an auditor asks about.

features.label: Central substitution variables, versioned
